CustomField.description: Next date the contract comes up for renewal. Standard contracts: Contract End Date. Auto-Renewal and Evergreen contracts: Contract End Date rolled forward in renewal periods until it lands on or after today, so the field stays current after the contract auto-renews without anyone editing the asset. Renewal period = Renewal Term (Months) when entered, otherwise 12 months (changed 2026-09-23: the initial-term default rolled multi-year contracts 3+ years out). Blank when Contract End Date is blank. Added Sep 2026.
CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISBLANK(Contract_End_Date__c), ISPICKVAL(Contract_Term_Type__c, "Standard"), Contract_End_Date__c >= TODAY() ), Contract_End_Date__c, IF( ADDMONTHS( Contract_End_Date__c, FLOOR( ((YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(Contract_End_Date__c)) * 12 + (MONTH(TODAY()) - MONTH(Contract_End_Date__c)) - IF(DAY(TODAY()) < DAY(Contract_End_Date__c), 1, 0)) / IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Renewal_Term_Months__c)) && Renewal_Term_Months__c > 0, Renewal_Term_Months__c, 12) ) * IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Renewal_Term_Months__c)) && Renewal_Term_Months__c > 0, Renewal_Term_Months__c, 12) ) = TODAY(), TODAY(), ADDMONTHS( Contract_End_Date__c, (FLOOR( ((YEAR(TODAY()) - YEAR(Contract_End_Date__c)) * 12 + (MONTH(TODAY()) - MONTH(Contract_End_Date__c)) - IF(DAY(TODAY()) < DAY(Contract_End_Date__c), 1, 0)) / IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Renewal_Term_Months__c)) && Renewal_Term_Months__c > 0, Renewal_Term_Months__c, 12) ) + 1) * IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Renewal_Term_Months__c)) && Renewal_Term_Months__c > 0, Renewal_Term_Months__c, 12) ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Next renewal date. Standard: the Contract End Date. Auto-Renewal and Evergreen: the end date rolled forward in renewal periods (Renewal Term (Months), else 12 months) until it is on or after today.
CustomField.label: Renewal Date
